q: The Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH) for non-integrable quantum systems says that for a local observable A in energy eigenstate |Eₙ⟩:
opts: ⟨Eₙ|A|Eₙ⟩ ≈ ⟨A⟩_{thermal} (eigenstate expectation = thermal average at energy Eₙ)
exp: ETH (Deutsch 1991, Srednicki 1994): in non-integrable (chaotic) quantum systems, individual energy eigenstates look thermal — local observables take their thermal equilibrium values. This is the quantum analogue of ergodicity: single eigenstates encode the full statistical mechanics.
